guides.title: 工程操作與定量驗證手冊
guides.concept: 本課以「分辨飛灰污染總量、固定化效能與長期浸出證據」為主軸，依序處理飛灰與防制殘渣界定、乾基添加量、固定介質容量概念、洗液與污染轉移、穩定化能耗比較。十個單元各包含機制、算例、量測驗證及失效診斷；數值均為明示的原創教學假設，不能直接用作工程設計、排放限值或設備設定。
guides.conceptEn: This course focuses on Distinguish fly-ash inventory, immobilization performance and long-term leaching evidence, progressing through Fly ash and control-residue identification, Dry-basis amendment quantity, Immobilizing-media capacity, Wash water and contaminant transfer, Stabilization energy comparison. Ten units each address mechanism, worked calculation, measurement verification and failure diagnosis. Numbers are explicit original teaching assumptions, not design values, emission limits or equipment settings.
procedure: 只將 f 改成 0.22，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 180 變成 220 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 r 改成 0.70，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 270 變成 210 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 d 改成 0.15 kg/kg，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 120 變成 150 kg。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將假想 w 改成 0.25，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 33.3333 kg water。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 L 改成 0.40 kg/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 50 d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 C 改成 3 mg/L，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 40 變成 60 mg/kg dry sample。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 Q 改成 150 m³/d，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 30 變成 37.5 kg/d。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 a 改成 300 m²，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 25 變成 34 sample cells。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 f 改成 0.2 kg CO₂e/kWh，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 80 變成 40 kg CO₂e/t。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
只將 uC 改成 0.03，其餘輸入固定。重算結果應由 0.072111 變成 0.05 relative standard uncertainty。先預測方向，再核對單位與假設；用離線模擬或已提供資料完成，不操作現場設備。
procedureEn: Change only f to 0.22, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 180 to 220 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only capture r to 0.70, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 270 to 210 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only d to 0.15 kg/kg, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 120 to 150 kg. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only hypothetical w to 0.25, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 33.3333 kg water. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only loading L to 0.40 kg/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 50 d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only C to 3 mg/L, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 40 to 60 mg/kg dry sample. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only Q to 150 m³/d, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 30 to 37.5 kg/d. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only cell area a to 300 m², holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 25 to 34 sample cells. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only grid factor f to 0.2 kg CO₂e/kWh, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 80 to 40 kg CO₂e/t. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.

Change only uC to 0.03, holding all other inputs fixed. Recalculation changes 0.072111 to 0.05 relative standard uncertainty. Predict the direction first, then check units and assumptions; use offline simulation or supplied data without operating field equipment.
evidence: 針對「飛灰與防制殘渣界定」，秤總樣與分離後成分，保存含水率與分樣方式，檢查回收率。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「粒徑與均質分樣」，分別量進料與兩出口的粒徑分布，檢查堵孔、含水與旁通。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「乾基添加量」，核對秤重及乾基換算，保留試樣批次並比較不同劑量的性能。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「混合含水與成形」，分開記錄原料自帶水與外加水，量混合後濕乾重量並檢查反應消耗和滲液。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「固定介質容量概念」，做突破曲線並記錄流量、濃度與介質狀態，將可用容量與總化學容量分開。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「浸出方法與液固比」，記錄方法、空白、液固比和乾重，將浸出 mg/L 與換算 mg/kg 分欄呈現。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「洗液與污染轉移」，對齊流量計與採樣時間，以分時段 Q×C 加總，核對總量與單位。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「批次品質與採樣格」，將網格覆在地形與歷史活動圖上，保留障礙區與針對性樣本的理由。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「穩定化能耗比較」，保存電表邊界、產量與係數版本，對替代電力情境作敏感度分析。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
針對「不確定度與長期證據」，建立每項不確定度來源表，將重複性、校正和代表性分開，檢查相關性。 保存原始資料、單位與校正日期，以本步模型和另一種可能原因比較。
evidenceEn: For Fly ash and control-residue identification, Weigh the bulk sample and separated fraction; retain moisture basis and sampling procedure and check recovery. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Particle size and representative splitting, Measure feed and both outlet size distributions, checking blinded apertures, moisture and bypass. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Dry-basis amendment quantity, Check weighing and dry-basis conversion, retain batch IDs and compare performance across doses. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Blend moisture and forming, Record inherent and added water separately, measure wet and dry blend masses and check reaction consumption and drainage. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Immobilizing-media capacity, Measure breakthrough with flow, concentration and media condition; distinguish usable from total chemical capacity. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Leaching method and liquid-solid ratio, Record method, blanks, liquid/solid ratio and dry mass; display leachate mg/L separately from converted mg/kg. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Wash water and contaminant transfer, Align flow-meter and sampling timestamps; sum interval Q×C and check totals and units. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Batch quality and sampling coverage, Overlay the grid on terrain and historical activities; document inaccessible cells and targeted samples. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Stabilization energy comparison, Record metering boundary, output and factor version; test alternative electricity scenarios. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.

For Uncertainty and long-term evidence, Build an uncertainty budget separating repeatability, calibration and representativeness; inspect correlations. Retain raw data, units and calibration date; compare the model with one alternative explanation.
pitfalls: 濕基與乾基混用會令回收物或負荷被高估。 在「飛灰與防制殘渣界定」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
濕料結團讓可回收細粒留在粗料中。 在「粒徑與均質分樣」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
靠稀釋降低總濃度不等於化學固定或長期穩定。 在「乾基添加量」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把濕基百分比直接乘乾料重會低估水量。 在「混合含水與成形」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只用理論反應容量會高估介質壽命。 在「固定介質容量概念」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
浸出液 mg/L 誤標成固體 mg/kg 會改變結論。 在「浸出方法與液固比」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
只比較濃度會把稀釋當成污染質量已移除。 在「洗液與污染轉移」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
規則網格漏掉小型污染熱點，需與歷史與現場證據合併。 在「批次品質與採樣格」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
把不同年份或系統邊界的係數混用會產生假比較。 在「穩定化能耗比較」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
增加同偏差的重複測量不能消除系統性誤差。 在「不確定度與長期證據」的流程圖圈出錯誤可能進入的位置，再指定能區分原因的量測。
pitfallsEn: Mixing wet and dry bases overstates recovered material or loading. Mark where this error can enter the Fly ash and control-residue identification flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Wet agglomeration retains recoverable fines in the coarse stream. Mark where this error can enter the Particle size and representative splitting flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Dilution of total concentration is not chemical immobilization or long-term stability. Mark where this error can enter the Dry-basis amendment quantity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Multiplying a wet-basis percentage directly by dry mass understates water. Mark where this error can enter the Blend moisture and forming flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Using theoretical reaction capacity alone overestimates media life. Mark where this error can enter the Immobilizing-media capacity flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Labelling leachate mg/L as solid mg/kg changes the interpretation. Mark where this error can enter the Leaching method and liquid-solid ratio flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

A concentration-only comparison can mistake dilution for pollutant removal. Mark where this error can enter the Wash water and contaminant transfer flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

A regular grid may miss small hotspots and must be combined with history and field evidence. Mark where this error can enter the Batch quality and sampling coverage flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.
Mixing factors across years or boundaries creates misleading comparisons. Mark where this error can enter the Stabilization energy comparison flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

Repeating measurements with the same bias does not remove systematic error. Mark where this error can enter the Uncertainty and long-term evidence flow and name a measurement that distinguishes causes.

courses.summary: 這項技術的學習脈絡由單一設備處理，逐步擴展至物質與能量收支、監測品質和生命週期比較。本課將官方方法文件作為查核入口，並以獨立編寫的假想數據練習；參考文件的年代與地區不代表其規範在所有場址適用。
courses.summaryEn: The learning progression expands from individual treatment equipment to mass and energy balances, monitoring quality and lifecycle comparison. Official method documents provide verification starting points while independently authored hypothetical data support practice; a document date or jurisdiction does not establish applicability to every site.
